development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude Code 2.1.284 with claude-opus-5-5 (settings model 'opus', effort high; max was also set during the session). Built-in tools only. uv 0.12.15, Python 3.13.15, pytest 9.1.1, ruff 0.16.10 via uvx, Chromium 152 for UI screenshots. Playwright 1.63.0 through `uv run --with playwright` (not a project dependency) for the headless sign-in and chat check of the rewritten page; Docker Compose 5.5.1 for `docker compose config` only (no daemon).

plugins_and_extensions.notes: ponytail 4.10.0, commit e3ba2aa6f1e6f0bc4d69eb09c9f0d0a93af56156, user scope, MIT, from https://github.com/dietrichgebert/ponytail.git. Only its hooks affected the session; its bundled skills and MCP server were not invoked.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: OpenAI Chat Completions through langchain-openai ChatOpenAI (use_responses_api=False: 1.6.7 otherwise switches gpt-6 models with tools to the Responses API), run as a LangGraph 1.2.14 graph guard -> reason <-> act. gpt-6-luna, reasoning_effort none, provider default temperature and max tokens, strict function tools, parallel_tool_calls false, timeout 60 s, 2 retries. tool_choice: guard forces its verdict tool; reason uses auto on a question's first call, required after a tool result, and forces submit_report at the query limit; compaction uses none. Chosen by evals/run_eval.py against gpt-5.6-luna and gpt-6-sol; v6 re-measured on 14 questions x 3. Each run records its model settings under config. The api container is FastAPI 0.142.2 on uvicorn 0.54.0 (httpx 0.28.1 in dev, for TestClient); it calls the agent container over HTTP for every question.

skills.notes: Two skills guided the web UI, neither installed in the project: Claude Code's bundled dataviz skill (chart palette, mark rules and its palette validator, run against the page's surfaces) and the third-party ui-ux-pro-max skill (cloned at the commit below, used as a reference: its local search script and rule lists for the UI audit; it makes no network calls). No skills were created. The ponytail ruleset reached the session through its SessionStart hook (see hooks_and_scripts), not as a skill call.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: No CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md at project or user level, no subagent definitions, and no subagents were spawned. The application's model instructions are under prompts_and_rules.

hooks_and_scripts.notes: SessionStart, SubagentStart and UserPromptSubmit hooks from the ponytail plugin. Local Node.js scripts with no network calls. They write a mode flag under ~/.claude and inject the SKILL.md ruleset (level full). What each does is in ai-workflow/README.md.

prompts_and_rules.notes: The system prompt is prompts/system-v9.md plus the domain.md rules (without the worked example) plus schema.sql. guard-v2 classifies each new message (allow / off_topic / unsafe; small talk is off_topic since v2); compact-v1 summarizes history beyond 20 messages. Prompt versions are immutable named snapshots; runs record their paths and one SHA over all three. report.py holds the report schema with field descriptions; since v9 the Finding.kind description also carries the 'why needs an unknown finding' rule.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: Claude Code built-in tools with default settings. No MCP servers configured for this project. Account-level claude.ai connectors were available in the session but not used, so they are not exported.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: Claude Code ran in auto permission mode, a session setting; there are no permission rules in settings.json. Application variables: LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_API_KEY, LLM_MODEL, LLM_REASONING_EFFORT, LLM_MAX_TOKENS (default 4096), LLM_EXTRA_BODY (provider-specific JSON, e.g. Claude thinking off); .env.example has OpenAI, Anthropic and generic presets. OPENROUTER_API_KEY was used during development only, to check model availability and prices. .env is gitignored.
